landing.heroSubtitle: Munchie Master is where happy tummies and happy families meet!
about: Trying to eat healthy, stay fit, and keep up with work and everyday life?
I know the struggle! I’m Ellie, a web developer, and I’ve found that one of the biggest challenges is simply figuring out what to eat when life gets busy.

Without a little meal prep, it’s so easy to reach for something quick and forget about those healthy goals. That’s why I created Munchie Master, a place to collect easy-to-prepare, nutritious, and healthy recipes.

Now, I’d love for you to be part of it! Share your favorite easy recipes, discover new meal ideas, and help us build a collection of simple, delicious, and nutritious meals that actually fit into our busy lives.
